title: Oceanic Flaky Korean White Fish Deopbap
description: A savory and flaky one-pot Korean dish featuring white fish, served in a hot-pot vessel, this recipe is FODMAP-friendly and easy to make.
instructions: Heat the garlic-infused oil in the hot-pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the white fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Remove the fish from the vessel and set aside.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper to the vessel and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Add the green onions to the vessel and cook for 1 minute, or until wilted.
Return the fish to the vessel and spoon some of the sauce over the top.
Serve the fish and sauce over rice, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
